blurb: Guests join early morning surf launched dory fishing trips off Cape Kiwanda to catch salmon, bottom fish, and crab. Trips include cleaning, filleting, weighing, vacuum sealing fish, and cooking crab. Trips are limited to six guests and operate March through September.
extraNote: No refund if trip is canceled within two months of date of charter · 5% processing fee for credit card cancellations · Trips canceled due to inclement weather are refunded or rescheduled · $100 deposit per person required when booking · Payment accepted by cash, check, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, Zelle, and Venmo · Beach launch at Cape Kiwanda, Pacific City, Oregon · March through September
